baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Continuous coursing is enclosed by eye-as-care; recompense makes that protected motion a counter-gift answering the prior denial of a person.

activation_trace.role: Coursing and flowing supply sustained motion as the vehicle of the answer.
The eye as preservation and oversight turns seeing into active custodial care.
Requital for an act makes the course itself compensatory rather than incidental.
Occurrence in prior time marks denial as an endured state to which the present course answers.
Concealment and denial of truth identify the injury reversed by recompense.

changed_reading.before: An unnamed feminine subject moves while God sees it, as a reward associated with disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The motion is active protective requital: divine care sustains a course for the person whose truth had been denied.

baseline_models.mechanism: The preposition with plural eyes permits a water-source activation: flowing proceeds by means of divine springs without cancelling the stronger care reading.

activation_trace.role: Flowing supplies the motion that can be materially fed by a source.
The flowing spring supplies a possible material sense for the plural eyes and the medium of motion.

changed_reading.after: It may also run by means of Our water-sources, so the eyes evoke both supervising gaze and supplied flow.

baseline_models.mechanism: The sufficiency/substitution branch of recompense makes the running entity itself the provision that stands in for what the denied person lacked.

activation_trace.role: Actual coursing makes the recompense perform transport rather than remain an abstract award.
Standing in another's place and sufficing makes the moving subject a functional substitute.
Denial supplies the deficit for which the moving provision compensates.

changed_reading.before: A reward accompanies the subject's travel.
changed_reading.after: The traveling subject is itself a sufficient replacement furnished for the denied person; recompense takes the form of transport.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human sight registers a visible sign and then turns away; later sights are downcast. Against that failed gaze, Our eyes become the gaze that neither abandons nor misreads the protected course.

activation_trace.role: Watchful preservation supplies the stable counter-gaze around the moving subject.
Eye-sight and insight supply a human act of seeing whose failure sharpens divine seeing.
A manifest sign makes the human failure one of response, not lack of visibility.
Turning one's side away converts human seeing into abandonment and denial.
Eyesight in the downcast scene completes the reversal from dismissive vision to humbled vision.

structural_cues: 54:2 orders seeing a sign immediately before turning away.
54:7 lowers their sights, whereas 54:14 encloses the course within Our eyes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing, manifest sign, turning away, downcast sight, and preserving eyes; I infer a polemical contrast between unstable human attention and sustained divine attention. Alternatively, بِأَعْيُنِنَا may function only as a protection idiom.

changed_reading.before: Our eyes indicate protection during movement.
changed_reading.after: Our eyes also answer the pericope's failed human seeing: the denied sign remains accurately seen, valued, and carried by the divine gaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The servant is called false and repulsed, then calls while overpowered and asks for vindication. The running carrier is therefore the concrete counter-force through which recompense answers coercive denial.

activation_trace.role: Requital turns the ensuing movement into an answer proportioned to the preceding treatment.
Attributing falsehood supplies the social denial that the focus passive compresses.
Vocal repulsion gives the denial coercive force rather than leaving it an opinion.
Calling by speech supplies the appeal that links injury to response.
Overpowering force defines the imbalance that recompense must reverse.
Vindicating the wronged supplies the requested reversal embodied by the protected course.

structural_cues: 54:9-10 forms the chain denial and repulsion, confessed overpowering, then a plea for vindication.
The passive كُفِرَ in 54:14 looks backward to that treatment while جَزَآءً names its answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the injury-call-vindication sequence; I infer that the carrier's successful course is the form the requested vindication takes. A live alternative is that جَزَآءً marks general requital without a prayer-specific causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: The course is a generic protected reward.
changed_reading.after: The course is an answered appeal: transport under care reverses the public overpowering of the denied servant.

context_deltas.mechanism: Settled matter, an opened water outlet, earth's springs, converging waters, and measured decree form a controlled hydraulic corridor. The exact eye-root recurrence lets the focus eyes telescope supervision and water-source.

activation_trace.role: Coursing supplies the vessel's motion through the assembled water system.
The spring branch supplies the latent hydraulic layer inside Our eyes.
Fixity and settlement make the apparent drift part of an outcome already brought to rest.
Water issuing from an opened outlet supplies the upper feed into the corridor.
The explicit earth-springs materially realize the same root activated in the focus.
Two counterparts meeting supplies the convergence that creates one navigable flood.
Measured planning turns convergence and course into intentional routing rather than accident.

structural_cues: 54:11-12 moves from opened sky-water to earth-springs, their meeting, and a decreed matter before 54:14 says the carrier runs.
ع ي ن occurs as عُيُونًا in 54:12 and أَعْيُنِنَا in 54:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, springs, convergence, decree, and repeated ع ي ن; I infer that the context transfers a hydraulic resonance into بِأَعْيُنِنَا while preserving care. Alternatively, the repeated root may be an echo that does not alter the idiom's direct sense.

changed_reading.before: A protected carrier moves upon floodwater.
changed_reading.after: The carrier is routed through a deliberately opened, converged, and measured water system; Our eyes compress both watchful care and the springs that bear it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior verse supplies a load-bearing assemblage of broad planks and fasteners; the fasteners both bind the planks and name a ship that pushes water. The feminine runner is thus an engineered carrier whose functioning constitutes recompense.

activation_trace.role: Coursing predicates active motion of the immediately preceding material carrier.
Sufficing in another's place makes the carrier's work itself compensatory.
Lifting a visible load supplies the carrier-passenger relation.
Broad boards used for building supply the carrier's material body.
Fasteners that bind ship-planks supply structural integrity under force.
A ship pushing water turns the bound object into an active hydraulic carrier.

structural_cues: The feminine singular تَجْرِى immediately follows ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ.
54:13 moves from the carried person to the carrier's materials; 54:14 predicates motion of that carrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, load, boards, fasteners, and ship-motion; I infer the feminine antecedent and identify the carrier's successful operation with recompense. Alternatively, جَزَآءً can remain purpose or result without making carrier and recompense identical.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified feminine thing runs as a reward.
changed_reading.after: A fastened plank-carrier bears the denied person, and its engineered ability to keep running is the concrete form of recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The moving event is left as an enduring trace and visible sign, then enters remembrance and recitation. Recompense therefore outlives rescue as reproducible public evidence.

activation_trace.role: The transient course supplies the event later converted into a durable trace.
Leaving an effect behind converts completed movement into persistence.
A manifest sign turns the preserved effect into publicly legible evidence.
A reminder gives the sign an ongoing mnemonic function.
Reading and recitation supply the repeatable medium through which the trace continues to move.

structural_cues: 54:15 immediately converts the preceding episode into something left as a sign.
54:17 joins recitation to the repeated invitation to remember.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies motion, a left trace, sign, reminder, and recitation; I infer a temporal conversion from voyage to transmissible memory. A live alternative is that the feminine pronoun in 54:15 denotes the vessel, the event, or the sign tradition with different degrees of material persistence.

changed_reading.before: The recompense is a one-time successful voyage.
changed_reading.after: The voyage becomes a durable sign and repeatable remembrance, extending recompense into public memory.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This crosses shipbuilding into textual media, and no inscription is stated. It remains anchored by the agent branch of ج ر ي, the writable/building-board branch of ل و ح, and the ensuing sign and recitation; downstream prose should render it only as an as-if mnemonic analogy, not a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَجْرِى can activate an agent or envoy while its adjacent feminine antecedent is plank-built.

activation_trace.role: An agent, messenger, or representative lets the runner carry a communicative function.
A board used for writing or building supplies the material bridge between vessel and tablet.
A remaining effect lets the moving carrier leave communicative residue.
A visible sign supplies the message attributed analogically to the carrier.
Recitation supplies the later textual medium that receives the carrier's sign-function.

changed_reading.before: The vessel is only the object by which someone is carried.
changed_reading.after: As if a moving tablet-envoy, the plank-bodied carrier performs and then leaves a recitable message of recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activates the non-dominant ج ز ز mapping and the agricultural ك ف ر branch against the ordinary syntax of recompense for denial. The packet explicitly supplies both branches, while earth and springs give them a coherent material field; downstream prose should call it a harvest resonance only and never replace the primary requital reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَزَآءً and كُفِرَ admit packet-supplied cutting-time and seed-covering branch echoes within the running-and-springs field.

activation_trace.role: Harvest or cutting time at ripeness supplies a latent image of recompense coming due.
Covering seed with earth supplies a material analogue for truth hidden before its outcome appears.
Flowing supplies the movement that links the latent agrarian image to the focus event.
Soft fertile earth supplies the field in which covering and later outcome can cohere.
Released springs supply the water that turns the agrarian echo into a flood-borne reversal.

changed_reading.before: Recompense directly answers the denial of a person.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the branch field, the answer also resembles harvest time: what was covered like seed reaches its due disclosure while released springs bear the preserved subject.

strongest_changes: The denial-call-vindication sequence makes the protected voyage an embodied answer to coercive rejection.
The exact ع ي ن recurrence turns watchful eyes into a layered image of watchful springs inside a measured hydraulic corridor.
Planks and fasteners make recompense functional transport, while the following sign and remembrance extend it beyond the voyage.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses supervision, hydraulic causation, social reversal, engineered conveyance, and mnemonic afterlife into one running feminine subject; its split-root inventory also preserves a contained harvest resonance.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the spring sense enters بِأَعْيُنِنَا semantically or remains contextual wordplay beneath the dominant care idiom.
Whether كُفِرَ foregrounds denial of the messenger, ingratitude for a divine favor, or a controlled resonance of both.
Whether the feminine object left as a sign is the physical carrier, the event, or its transmitted account.
